description:
Convert selected Chinese text in the Mac app you are already writing in. Customizable global shortcuts can convert and replace a selection in an editable field, or open the selection in OpenCCman for review. Compatible apps can also use macOS Services. Replacement requires Accessibility permission and support from the source app; protected or read-only fields may not support it.

Compare source and result side by side or stacked, with independent layout choices for each window. Narrow windows temporarily stack the panes. Start with a blank draft, fill in an optional example, and use confirmed Clear Source to remove the current source and result.

Choose Simplified Chinese, OpenCC Traditional, Taiwan Standard with Taiwan idioms, or Hong Kong Traditional. Advanced character-variant and regional wording options remain available. Simplified output is not a complete reverse conversion of Taiwan-specific vocabulary.

Import or drop one UTF-8 TXT file up to 10 MiB into the editor, then copy, share or export the latest successful result. Pro on Mac also converts one UTF-8 TXT file larger than 10 MiB and up to 1 GiB directly to a new file. Choose the destination, follow progress and cancel when needed; the large file stays out of the editor, preserving your current draft and result.

On macOS 13 or later, the free Convert Chinese Text action returns text to the next Shortcuts action. Choose one of four presets and connect clipboard or file actions without changing an open draft. It does not use the homepage daily allowance; text input is limited to 10 MiB in UTF-8. Optional Launch at Login is also available on macOS 13 or later.

UTF-8 input can include a BOM; exported files have no BOM. Line endings, blank lines and Unicode text are preserved. Save Big5 or GBK files as UTF-8 first. Files are converted one at a time; batch conversion is not supported.

Free users can complete 12 successful homepage conversions per day, shared across windows. Importing, exporting and changing presets do not count. Lifetime Pro is a one-time purchase that removes the homepage limit and in-app recommendations and unlocks Mac large-file conversion. View purchase status or restore purchases in Settings.

Powered by OpenCC, text conversion runs locally on your Mac. OpenCCman requires macOS 12 or later. Open source under the MIT license: https://github.com/gewill/OpenCCman
whatsNew:
Pro on Mac can now convert a UTF-8 TXT file up to 1 GiB directly to a new file, keeping your current draft and result in place.

• Large-file conversion supports one file larger than 10 MiB, with progress and cancellation.
• Free Convert Chinese Text action on macOS 13 or later: choose from four presets and return text to the next Shortcuts action without using your homepage daily allowance.
• New workspaces start blank, with an optional example. Clear Source asks for confirmation.
• The global Convert shortcut checks that the selected text and editable target have not changed before replacing them. If the target cannot be confirmed, the result remains in OpenCCman for manual copying.
• Updated app icon and launch visuals. The launch transition respects Reduce Motion and is skipped when VoiceOver is enabled.
